description:
The adjustable push handle lets parents take control with ease, making guided rides smooth and effortless. With a comfortable grip and thoughtful design, steering your little one’s adventures has never been simpler.
The padded seat, headrest, and cushioned harness keep your little rider cozy, while the removable UV canopy shields them from the sun. Every ride is smooth, stylish, and ultra-comfortable.
As your little one gains confidence, the Malmo Ultra converts into a fully independent trike. With a spacious rear storage bin, kids can bring along their favorite toys and essentials for every ride.
The Malmo Ultra 4-in-1 Stroller & Trike transitions through every stage of your child’s journey, from parent-guided strolls to independent pedaling. With easy steering, a secure harness, and thoughtful storage, every ride is a breeze for both parents and little adventurers.
